_meanings:
.²1 Town-born, town-bred.
.²2 Relating to a town, civic.
.²3 Spoken in a town.
.²4 Polite, civil.
.²5 Clever, sharp.
.²6 Bad, vile, one who has contracted the vices of a town. {#nAganAgarayormaDye#}
 {#varaM nAgo na nAgaraH . nAgo daSati kAlena nAgarastu punaH punaH ..#} <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>
.²7 Nameless.

.²1 A citizen ({#pOra#}); {#yaH paRyastrIratiparimalodgAriBirnAgarARAmuddAmAni#}
 {#praTayati SilAveSmaBiryOvanAni#} <ls>Me. 25</ls>; <ls>Śānti. 4. 19</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 10. 56. 17</ls>.
.²2 A husbandʼs brother.
.²3 A lecturer.
.²4 An orange.
.²5 Fatigue; hardship, toil.
.²6 Desire of final beatitude.
.²7 A term applied to a prince engaged in war under certain circumstances
 and also to a planet when in opposition to other planets (in <ab>astrol.</ab>)
.²8 Denial of knowledge.

.²1 The character in which Sanskrit is generally written; <ab>cf.</ab> {#devanAgarI#}.
